title: Ellis Blè - Closure (Heartbreak in Paris)
htmlContent:
Ellis Blè's "Closure (Heartbreak in Paris)" is a big time record from a big time talent the world will enjoy. Its a song packed with appeal and soul that makes you not only enjoy the music, but feel the music to put this record in a special class of its own. The production is smooth, that push this song forward, and sets an amazing tone for her vocal presence to command the listener. The writing is top level and amazing in it’s story telling to help it shine to the fullest.
